title: ci(spec-main-shape-gate): drop the `merge_group` trigger once the ruleset reads INTACT on seven — an advisory verdict on a queue build is read by nobody (objectui#12240 follow-up, letter B)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #37, `session_01LqNgdPZB2Jnr5HpGbaqLeB`) from the objectui#12240 dev's open question 1 (report 6124777533), decided B by this seat under the maintainer's standing order 「三仓的 ci 优化卡你负责派发」 and objectstack#22998's rule that only the fast set runs on the queue. Filing gate ③: a consequence of ruling B on objectui#12240. ⛔ Not a claim. Tier H posture: `.github/workflows/**`, the PR stays a draft until a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` member approves it. **Serial:** lands only after the maintainer's ruleset edit from objectui#12240 is read back (`node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` live → `INTACT` on the seven names); before that, dropping the trigger would stall this PR's own queue build at the 60-minute timeout (the #12240 dev's reading).

## Why
`spec-main-shape-gate.yml` keeps `merge_group` in PR #12250 only because the ruled order on objectui#12240 is merge first, ruleset edit second. Once `Spec Main Shape Gate` is no longer required, its verdict on a merge group is read by nobody: the newest 100 completed `merge_group` runs (2026-10-09..12) are about 33.6 a day at 13.1 min median wall, about 440 runner-minutes a day of public-runner occupancy for no reader.

## What to build
1. Remove `merge_group` from the workflow's `on:`; keep `pull_request` (the advisory signal a human reads), `schedule` (the hourly full-battery run on `main`) and `workflow_dispatch`.
2. `scripts/__tests__/spec-main-shape-gate.test.ts`: the pin "subscribes merge_group, so a maintainer can enrol it without stalling the queue" becomes "re-subscribe `merge_group` before re-enrolling" (merge-queue-reporting's derived floor already refuses a required name whose workflow lacks the trigger); the workflow's `concurrency` and `timeout-minutes` comments that reason about queue builds move with it.
3. Nothing else: the gate's verification, the marker, the schedule and the seven-name pin stay as PR #12250 leaves them.

## Acceptance
- `node scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` live reads `INTACT` on seven before the PR is opened (quote the reading in the PR body); the gate's workflow parses with three triggers; the test file's pin reds on an ablation that restores `merge_group` requiredness without the trigger; three merge groups after landing carry no `Spec Main Shape Gate` check run.

Related: objectui#12240 (PR #12250) · objectui#12214 · objectstack#22998 · `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml`.
